channel.title: Teachers :: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: Materials for teachers: competency matrix (curriculum traceability), weekly schedule and rubric templates.

item.title: Competency Matrix
item.description: This page is the coursebook’s curriculum evidence: for each of the 27 competencies from the Lehrplan für Informatik und KI (the Austrian curriculum for computer science and AI), it shows the exact wording, the stated grade/semester, and the project or self-study path that covers it. Note: German is the source of truth for the exact legal wording. This English page is a working translation for orientation; where in doubt, defer to the German page.

item.title: Lesson Plans
item.description: Minute-by-minute plans for individual double lessons (around 95 min planned). They complement the weekly schedule and link to the student pages in the project section.
